title: nixos/roundcube: increase client_max_body_size for maxAttachmentSize
reason: Applicable: real roundcube module + wired test. Real diff adds a genuinely new use SITE of the existing maxAttachmentSize option (nginx `client_max_body_size ${toString cfg.maxAttachmentSize};`) -- same declared option as batch1's PR473031, not a new declaration.
targets_toml: single target roundcube, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,roundcube], watch=[maxAttachmentSize] (same as batch1's PR473031, deliberately, to see if a new use site changes the verdict).

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: Unchanged, correctly, consistent with batch1's own PR473031 finding: maxAttachmentSize is used only as value substitutions (now in a second config-generation site too), never as a branch/predicate condition -- a new use site doesn't change the module-wide predicate-discovery verdict. Not a new finding.
